title: Financial Reporting Services
summary: Monthly MIS and dashboards, annual financial statements, Ind AS and IFRS reporting, and group consolidation.
metaTitle: Financial Reporting Services: MIS, IFRS and Ind AS
metaDescription: Financial reporting for India and the GCC: monthly MIS with live dashboards, year-end statements under Indian GAAP, Ind AS or IFRS, and group consolidation.
heroIntro: The numbers you actually manage the business with, and the statements lenders, investors and regulators expect.
overview:
Reporting is where good bookkeeping turns into decisions. Every plan includes a one-page MIS and a live dashboard by the 7th. Year-end statements follow Indian GAAP in India and IFRS for SMEs in the Gulf, with Ind AS or full IFRS available as add-ons, and consolidation for groups.

Reports are prepared from your books, reviewed by a qualified accountant and sent only after review.
whatWeDo: Prepare the monthly profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flow with commentary.
Track key performance indicators such as gross margin, receivable days and cash runway.
Build a live dashboard that summarises the key numbers in one view.
Prepare annual financial statements with notes and schedules.
Complete year-end closing: accruals, provisions, depreciation and tax adjustments.
Prepare management accounts packs for banks and investors.

byPlan.foundation: Standard one-page MIS, live dashboard and year-end statements.
byPlan.growth: Custom KPIs, variance commentary, interim statements and lender packs on request.
byPlan.cfo: Forecast-linked MIS with scenarios, investor-grade reporting and consolidation support.

note: Reports are prepared from your books, reviewed by a qualified accountant, and sent only after review.

faqs.q: What is in the monthly MIS?
faqs.a: A one-page summary of profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flow with commentary, plus a live dashboard link. Growth and CFO add custom KPIs, department or project views and variance commentary.

faqs.q: Which accounting standards do you report under?
faqs.a: Indian GAAP is standard in India, and IFRS for SMEs in the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Ind AS and full IFRS are available as add-ons.
